title: curcuma zerumbet
intro: Curcuma zerumbet, commonly known as lantana leaf ginger or wild turmeric, is a plant species native to tropical regions of Asia and the Pacific Islands. It has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, offering various health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of arthritis, digestive issues, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Curcuma zerumbet include antioxidant, anti-cancer, and neuroprotective effects, which can help protect against cell damage, cancer cell growth, and neurodegenerative diseases. The plant's bioactive constituents include zerumbone, curcumenol, and other sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
